#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

class IO {
private:
    std::string buffer;
    size_t pos;
    std::ostringstream out;

    void skipWhitespace() {
        while (pos < buffer.size() && std::isspace(buffer[pos])) {
            ++pos;
        }
    }

    void refillBuffer() {
        if (std::getline(std::cin, buffer)) {
            pos = 0;
        }
    }

public:
    IO() : pos(0) {}

    std::string next() {
        skipWhitespace();
        if (pos >= buffer.size()) {
            refillBuffer();
            skipWhitespace();
        }
        
        size_t start = pos;
        while (pos < buffer.size() && !std::isspace(buffer[pos])) {
            ++pos;
        }
        return buffer.substr(start, pos - start);
    }

    int nextInt() {
        std::string s = next();
        try {
            return std::stoi(s);
        } catch (...) {
            throw std::runtime_error("IO.nextInt: Invalid int.");
        }
    }

    long long nextLong() {
        std::string s = next();
        try {
            return std::stoll(s);
        } catch (...) {
            throw std::runtime_error("IO.nextLong: Invalid long.");
        }
    }

    void println(long long val) {
        out << val << "\n";
    }

    void println(int val) {
        out << val << "\n";
    }

    ~IO() {
        std::cout << out.str();
    }
};

class Solver {
private:
    IO io;

    long long brute1(long long m) {
        long long ans = 6 * (m / 6);
        long long remainder = m % 6;
        if (remainder == 5) ans += 4;
        else if (remainder == 4) ans += 2;
        return ans;
    }

public:
    Solver() {
        try {
            solve();
        } catch (const std::runtime_error& e) {
            if (std::string(e.what()) != "Clean exit") {
                throw;
            }
        }
    }

    void solve() {
        long long n = io.nextLong();
        long long m = io.nextLong();
        
        if (m < n) {
            long long temp = m;
            m = n;
            n = temp;
        }

        if (n == 1) {
            io.println(brute1(m));
            return;
        }
        if (n == 2) {
            if (m < 3) io.println(0);
            else if (m == 3) io.println(4);
            else if (m == 7) io.println(12);
            else io.println(2 * m);
            return;
        }

        long long total = n * m;
        long long result = (total >> 1) << 1;
        io.println(result);
    }
};

int main() {
    new Solver();
    return 0;
}
